body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea RELATIVISTIC JET: matte black body = the black hole, lens = its centre. Along the spin axis a slender satin light-grey column set into the front runs from the lens up over the top edge and down to the bottom edge: two jets fired from the poles. Its raised ring knots, tight near the lens and spreading toward the ends, are finger ribs. A thin knife-edge disc crosses it horizontally at the lens, an accretion disk seen edge-on. On top it ends in a machined cap with the slide switch and two light-pipe dots; below in a ribbed foot ring with vent slots round the USB-C, so it stands to charge. image[2] = upright tube body, satin finish. image[3] = vertical machined column with stacked rings. image[4] = ribbed ring with red index triangle, for the lens. Knurled side panel, plug cover, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
